title: Daniel Chapter 10 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Daniel chapter 10 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Daniel Chapter 10 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Daniel Chapter 10.

questions.question: In which year of Cyrus king of Persia was the revelation given to Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:1 states that the revelation was given in the third year of Cyrus king of Persia.

questions.question: What was Daniel's other name mentioned in the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:1 says Daniel's name was called Belteshazzar.

questions.question: How long did Daniel mourn before receiving the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:2 states that Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

questions.question: During his mourning, which of the following did Daniel abstain from?
options: No pleasant bread, no flesh, no wine
No water, no bread, no oil
No meat, no fish, no water
No bread, no honey, no wine
questions.correctAnswer: No pleasant bread, no flesh, no wine
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:3 explains that Daniel ate no pleasant bread, neither flesh nor wine came into his mouth.

questions.question: Where was Daniel standing when he lifted his eyes to see the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:4 states Daniel was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel.

questions.question: How was the man Daniel saw in the vision clothed?
options: In linen with loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz
questions.correctAnswer: In linen with loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:5 describes the man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz.

questions.question: Which of the following descriptions did NOT apply to the man in the vision?
options: His eyes were like lamps of fire
His voice was soft and gentle
questions.correctAnswer: His voice was soft and gentle
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:6 says the voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude, not soft and gentle.

questions.question: Who saw the vision according to Daniel 10?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:7 explains that only Daniel saw the vision; the men with him did not see it.

questions.question: What happened to the men with Daniel when the vision appeared?
options: They began to speak in tongues
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:7 states a great quaking fell upon the men, so that they fled to hide themselves.

questions.question: True or False: Daniel ate flesh and drank wine during the three weeks he mourned.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:3 confirms Daniel neither ate flesh nor drank wine during his mourning.

questions.question: True or False: Daniel was left alone when he saw the great vision.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:8 states that Daniel was left alone and saw the great vision.

questions.question: True or False: The voice of the man in the vision was like the voice of a single person speaking quietly.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:6 says the voice was like the voice of a multitude, not a single quiet person.

questions.question: True or False: The man in linen had loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:5 describes the man clothed in linen with his loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz.

questions.question: In Daniel 10, which event happens first?
options: Daniel sees a man clothed in linen
Daniel lifts his eyes by the river Hiddekel
Daniel’s companions flee to hide themselves
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:2-3 shows Daniel mourned for three weeks before seeing the vision or lifting his eyes by the river.

questions.question: What did Daniel do when he heard the voice of the man’s words?
options: He fell into a deep sleep on his face
questions.correctAnswer: He fell into a deep sleep on his face
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:9 states that when Daniel heard the voice, he was in a deep sleep on his face toward the ground.

medium.title: Daniel Chapter 10 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Daniel Chapter 10 to real-life situations.

questions.question: How long did Daniel mourn and fast before receiving the vision described in Daniel 10?
questions.explanation: Daniel mourned and fasted for three full weeks as stated in Daniel 10:2 and 10:3, during which he ate no pleasant bread, nor flesh or wine, and did not anoint himself.

questions.question: What was Daniel doing when he saw the vision on the 24th day of the first month?
options: By the side of the great river Hiddekel
questions.correctAnswer: By the side of the great river Hiddekel
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:4 states that on the 24th day of the first month, Daniel was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel, when he saw the vision.

questions.question: What description best fits the man Daniel saw in his vision?
options: Clothed in rough garments with a staff
Clothed in linen with loins girded with fine gold
Wearing a crown and holding a scepter
Dressed in black robes with a sword
questions.correctAnswer: Clothed in linen with loins girded with fine gold
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:5 describes the man as clothed in linen, with his loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz, indicating a heavenly or exalted being.

questions.question: What effect did the vision have on Daniel's physical strength and appearance?
options: He felt energized and looked radiant
He lost all strength and his comeliness turned to corruption
He was filled with joy and danced
questions.correctAnswer: He lost all strength and his comeliness turned to corruption
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:8 explains that Daniel was left alone, saw the great vision, but had no strength; his comeliness turned into corruption and he retained no strength.

questions.question: What happened to Daniel when he heard the voice of the man's words in the vision?
options: He fell into a deep sleep on his face
He shouted to the people around him
questions.correctAnswer: He fell into a deep sleep on his face
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:9 states that when Daniel heard the voice of the man's words, he was in a deep sleep on his face, with his face toward the ground.

questions.question: What does Daniel 10:12 teach about the importance of setting one's heart to understand and to humble oneself before God?
options: That such prayers are heard from the first day
That only leaders are heard by God
questions.correctAnswer: That such prayers are heard from the first day
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:12 assures that from the first day Daniel set his heart to understand and to chasten himself before God, his words were heard, showing the value of earnest seeking and humility.

questions.question: According to Daniel 10:13, who helped the messenger against the prince of the kingdom of Persia?
options: Michael, one of the chief princes
questions.correctAnswer: Michael, one of the chief princes
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:13 reveals that Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help the messenger who was withstanding the prince of Persia for twenty-one days.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the vision that Daniel is about to understand, according to Daniel 10:14?
options: To reveal the immediate future of Persia
To explain the history of Greece
To show what shall befall Daniel's people in the latter days
To predict the fall of Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: To show what shall befall Daniel's people in the latter days
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:14 states that the vision is to make Daniel understand what will happen to his people in the latter days, emphasizing the prophetic and future-oriented nature of the revelation.

questions.question: What does the hand that touched Daniel in Daniel 10:10 do for him?
options: Lifts him up to stand on his knees and palms
Gives him a scroll to read
questions.correctAnswer: Lifts him up to stand on his knees and palms
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:10 describes that a hand touched Daniel and set him upon his knees and palms of his hands, indicating a preparation for receiving instruction or strength.

questions.question: How does the passage in Daniel 10:11-12 teach about God's response to faithful prayer and seeking?
options: God sends help when the heart is set to understand and humble
questions.correctAnswer: God sends help when the heart is set to understand and humble
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:11-12 shows that God sends a messenger to Daniel because from the first day Daniel set his heart to understand and humbled himself, indicating that sincere seeking is heard and answered.

questions.question: What does Daniel express about his own strength when speaking to the one who stood before him in Daniel 10:16-17?
options: He has no strength nor breath left in him
questions.correctAnswer: He has no strength nor breath left in him
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:16-17 records Daniel saying that his sorrows have overwhelmed him and he has retained no strength nor breath, showing his human weakness in the presence of the vision.

questions.question: What encouragement does the one like a man give Daniel in Daniel 10:18-19 after touching him again?
options: To be strong and have peace
questions.correctAnswer: To be strong and have peace
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:18-19 shows the figure encouraging Daniel to fear not, giving him peace and strength, enabling Daniel to speak and listen further.

questions.question: True or False: The prince of the kingdom of Persia allowed the messenger to pass quickly without any opposition.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:13 reveals that the prince of Persia withstood the messenger for twenty-one days, indicating significant opposition rather than quick passage.

questions.question: True or False: Daniel was the only one who saw the vision, while others with him fled because of a great quaking.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:7 states that Daniel alone saw the vision, and the men with him fled to hide because of a great quaking, confirming Daniel's unique experience.

questions.question: True or False: According to Daniel 10:21, Michael is described as the prince who supports the messenger in his struggles.
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:21 identifies Michael as the prince who holds with the messenger in these things, supporting him against opposing princes.

hard.title: Daniel Chapter 10 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Daniel Chapter 10.

questions.question: What was Daniel doing for three weeks during his mourning?
questions.explanation: Daniel stated he ate no pleasant bread, nor did he come flesh or wine in his mouth during the three weeks of mourning (Daniel 10:3).

questions.question: What does the appearance of the man in Daniel's vision resemble?
questions.explanation: The vision describes a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold (Daniel 10:5).

questions.question: Who was with Daniel during the vision but did not see it?
options: The men that were with him
questions.correctAnswer: The men that were with him
questions.explanation: Only Daniel saw the vision; the men that were with him did not see it but fled in fear (Daniel 10:7).

questions.question: What was Daniel's reaction upon hearing the voice during the vision?
options: He fell asleep on his face
questions.correctAnswer: He fell asleep on his face
questions.explanation: Upon hearing the voice, Daniel fell into a deep sleep with his face toward the ground (Daniel 10:9).

questions.question: What message did the angel bring to Daniel regarding his prayers?
options: They were heard from the first day
questions.correctAnswer: They were heard from the first day
questions.explanation: The angel informed Daniel that from the first day he set his heart to understand, his words were heard (Daniel 10:12).

questions.question: Who assisted the angel in delivering the message to Daniel?
questions.explanation: Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help the angel who was withstood by the prince of Persia (Daniel 10:13).

questions.question: What does the term 'greatly beloved' signify in the context of Daniel's vision?
options: He was favored by the king
He was loved by the people
questions.explanation: The angel addressed Daniel as 'O Daniel, a man greatly beloved,' indicating his special status before God (Daniel 10:11).

questions.question: True or False: Daniel received strength after he was touched by one like a man.
questions.explanation: After being touched, Daniel was strengthened and encouraged to be strong (Daniel 10:19).

questions.question: What did the angel intend to show Daniel?
options: What will befall his people in the latter days
The future of the Persian kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: What will befall his people in the latter days
questions.explanation: The angel came to make Daniel understand what shall befall his people in the latter days (Daniel 10:14).

questions.question: How does the phrase 'scripture of truth' relate to Daniel's vision?
options: It denotes a collection of laws
questions.explanation: The angel states he will show Daniel that which is noted in the scripture of truth, indicating the reliability and divine nature of the message (Daniel 10:21).

questions.question: Which New Testament passage parallels the theme of spiritual warfare found in Daniel 10?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6 discusses the spiritual armor and warfare, echoing the struggles Daniel faced with the prince of Persia (Daniel 10:13).

questions.question: In Daniel 10:20, what does the angel indicate he will do after speaking with Daniel?
options: Return to fight with the prince of Persia
questions.correctAnswer: Return to fight with the prince of Persia
questions.explanation: The angel says he will return to fight with the prince of Persia, indicating ongoing spiritual conflict (Daniel 10:20).

questions.question: True or False: The 'prince of Grecia' is mentioned as coming after the prince of Persia.
questions.explanation: The angel mentions that after dealing with the prince of Persia, the prince of Grecia shall come (Daniel 10:20).

questions.question: What literary device is used in Daniel 10 that emphasizes the importance of the message delivered to Daniel?
questions.explanation: The chapter begins and ends with significant messages that frame the vision, creating inclusio around Daniel's experiences and the angel's message.

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the word 'beloved' as used in Daniel 10:11?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word for 'beloved' indicates a special love or favor, highlighting Daniel's relationship with God (Daniel 10:11).

theological.title: Daniel Chapter 10 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Daniel Chapter 10 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What was revealed to Daniel in the third year of Cyrus king of Persia?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:1 states that a thing was revealed to Daniel, and he understood the thing and had understanding of the vision.

questions.question: How long did Daniel mourn before the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:2 clearly mentions that Daniel was mourning for three full weeks.

questions.question: What type of food did Daniel abstain from during his mourning?
questions.explanation: In Daniel 10:3, Daniel states that he ate no pleasant bread, nor came flesh or wine in his mouth.

questions.question: What river was Daniel by when he saw the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:4 refers to the great river, which is Hiddekel.

questions.question: What description is given of the man Daniel saw in the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:5 describes the certain man as being clothed in linen.

questions.question: What was the appearance of the man's body compared to?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:6 states that the man's body was like the beryl.

questions.question: Who saw the vision along with Daniel?
questions.explanation: According to Daniel 10:7, Daniel alone saw the vision while the men with him did not see it.

questions.question: What did the voice say to Daniel when he was touched?
questions.explanation: In Daniel 10:12, the voice reassured Daniel by saying, 'Fear not, Daniel.'

questions.question: Who assisted the speaker in the vision during the conflict with the prince of Persia?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:13 mentions Michael, one of the chief princes, coming to help the speaker.

questions.question: What does the speaker intend to explain to Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:14 indicates that the speaker has come to make Daniel understand what shall befall his people in the latter days.

questions.question: What did Daniel do when he heard the voice?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:9 states that upon hearing the voice, Daniel was in a deep sleep on his face toward the ground.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'O man greatly beloved' indicate about Daniel?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'O man greatly beloved' in Daniel 10:11 signifies God's special favor and affection towards Daniel.

questions.question: What does the speaker refer to when he mentions 'the scripture of truth'?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:21 refers to the scripture of truth, indicating the certainty and reliability of God's promises.

questions.question: What doctrinal significance is found in the struggle with the prince of Persia?
questions.explanation: The conflict described in Daniel 10:13 illustrates the reality of spiritual warfare, where angelic beings contend against opposing forces.

questions.question: How does Daniel 10 connect to the broader redemptive story of Scripture?
options: By demonstrating God's communication with His people
questions.correctAnswer: By demonstrating God's communication with His people
questions.explanation: Daniel 10 exemplifies God's ongoing interaction with His people, revealing His plans and providing reassurance during trials.
